about: Greek Breweries — Master Candidate List. Breweries we know of but have not verified. A brewery moves to Greek Beers/Catalog/<id>.json once its own website or recent products confirm it is active. Membership of a list is not verification. Check with: python3 Scripts/validate_catalog.py

statuses.unverified: Known from a list, not yet checked
statuses.inactive: Checked: closed, or no sign of activity
